provenance.prompt:
Create a clean pixel-art orthographic sprite atlas for the six Pocket Dungeon objects shown in the attached labeled source/current-view contact. Output exactly six columns and six rows: columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR; rows in this exact order: bubble-necropolis-deep-tomb-shaft; bubble-necropolis-sarcophagus; bubble-sea-submarine-metal-hull-closed-doorway; great-race-transition-emergency-descent-hatch; iron-stations-station-tiled-masonry-open-doorway; surface-entry-giant-fish-relief-doorway. One isolated object per cell, transparent background, no text, no cell borders, no extra pieces. Keep the same camera basis for all views. Orthographic straight-on horizontal elevations (no top visible in F/R/L/R) and true plan views looking vertically down/up for TOP/BOTTOM (no front faces). Match each source's palette and pixel cluster style. Use the contact's source and accepted directions as strict identity/material references; inferred unseen views must be physically coherent. Ensure every object stays inside its cell with clear gutters.
Row1 deep tomb shaft: horizontal square stone floor rim surrounding a deep dark pit; FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR are low thin horizontal stone/substrate edges, not upright walls; TOP is square overhead opening, BOTTOM is plausible full-footprint stone underside.
Row2 sarcophagus: lie coffin flat on ground along the long axis; TOP is the full decorated golden-and-blue coffin lid, BOTTOM full coffin underside, FRONT/REAR are long low side elevations and RIGHT/LEFT are short end elevations; consistent footprint and low height, no upright coffin.
Row3 submarine closed doorway: preserve heavy riveted gunmetal frame, yellow hazard stripe and central orange emblem. TOP is shallow horizontal lintel/depth profile, BOTTOM shallow threshold underside, RIGHT and LEFT true narrow depth profiles with the source's paired posts. Remove detached guide lines. Do not substitute a different door.
Row4 emergency descent hatch: preserve bright cyan raised lid, ladder and dark hatch box. REAR must show the back of the same raised lid and the rear support/hinge box in the same open state; no repeated front opening or forward lid face.
Row5 station open doorway: preserve pale masonry arch, teal side blocks and genuinely open dark passage. TOP is compact lintel/frame footprint; BOTTOM is a shallow threshold/support footprint; REAR also remains an open through-passage, not a sealed black panel.
Row6 giant fish relief doorway: preserve pale stone arch, teal side blocks and the source's green fish relief identity. TOP is a thin arch/lintel footprint, not a miniature frontal arch bent into XY; REAR is the solid reverse/back of the relief panel with the stone frame, not an empty opening.
All six rows use coherent object proportions between projections. Pixel art only; crisp opaque clusters, no blur, no shadows outside silhouettes. Do not draw labels or text.
